Title: Ghoul Retainer and Draught of the Soul

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Suppose Fatima is equipped with an Assault Rifle and Ivory Bow, and
also has hired a Ghoul Retainer. Suppose further this is a Storyline
event and she's just Blurred with the Rifle at range against Lambach
who had 10 blood and the Eye of Hazimel.

Lambach is going to burn (yay!) but can Fatima play Draught of the
Soul?

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 22 Sep 2003 21:53:35 -0700, jeff...@hotmail.com (Jeff Kuta)
scrawled:



How is Lambach going to burn?

Assuming the Ghoul Retainer uses the Ivory Bow, it happens during
normal strike resolution, sending Lambach to torpor before additional
strikes.

Assuming Fatima is using the Ivory Bow, at any given strike Lambach
will only be taking 1 agg damage, sending him to torpor.

If Lambach was at 3 blood to start, and you did 4 with the rifle and 1
agg with the bow in the initial strikes, Lambach would burn. (X+2=5,
where X=3)

The Ghoul Retainer does not gain any additional strikes of it's
employer.

Nope. :)

He is taking 4 normal and 1 agg all at the same time, the initial
strike resolution phase.

you handle normal first, then agg.

so, he burns 1,2,3 blood for the first 3 points of normal damage. he's
taking another normal damage, he has no blood to heal, so he becomes
wounded. the then wounded Lambach handles the point of agg. when a
wounded vamp takes agg, it must burn a blood or be burned. lambach has
no blood at that point, so he burns.

you just need x+2 damage, where _at least_ 1 is agg, to burn someone.
the damage all has to be being applied at the same time, though.

it's all there in the rulebook.

>He doesn't burn.

Yes he does. :)

I'd be inclined to aggree on that point.

If the retainer and fatima were both doing agg to lambach at the same
time, i guess the acting minion gets to choose which order the agg is
applied, to determine whether fatima or the retainer burns lambach?

The flaw in the set-up has already been pointed out.

But, if the flaw is worked out and Lambach burns during the resolution
of Fatima's strike (with or without the help of the retainer), Fatima
can play Draught of the Soul.

Ok. So perhaps the situation can't be as dramatic as I would wish, but
the question is still valid: If a vampire with Quietus employs a Ghoul
Retainer which wields the weapon that causes their opponent in combat
to be burned, may the vampire play Draught of the Soul?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Kuta wrote:
> Ok. So perhaps the situation can't be as dramatic as I would wish, but
> the question is still valid: If a vampire with Quietus employs a Ghoul
> Retainer which wields the weapon that causes their opponent in combat
> to be burned, may the vampire play Draught of the Soul?

If that vampire was in on the burning, yes.
If the vampire dodges while the Ghoul uses a Bang Nakh in a Dawn Operation,
no (since the vampire didn't "burn another vampire" as required by card
text).
If the vampire punches for 1 and the Ghoul uses a Flamethrower for 2 agg
against a vampire that has only 1 blood and doesn't prevent, then yes.



Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
the_capuchin wrote:
> So I assume that in the Lambach-with-3-blood hypothesis one must
> DECLARE that the Retainer is using the rifle and Fatima is using the
> Ivory. Is it correct?

The minion must always declare a strike during the choose strikes phase,
of course.

Fatima need not be the one using the Bow, however, since the effects are
applied simultaneously.
